policy: Shared PC changes require a reviewed Android port before publication. Release-number-only changes are ignored. Desktop-only files remain separate.

review_notes.starter_reset: Shared save_data, paths guard and game_reset are ported; Android preserves app PCK storage. Android22 tests cover compiled APK scripts, both touch modes, import and persistence after reset.
review_notes.launcher_controls: Android includes the current settings layout with a separate persisted Hold/Menu row and confirmed reset.
review_notes.launcher_and_outline: PC library/import UI and its logo-outline shader remain desktop presentation. Android retains its dedicated installed-game library and native PCK importer; it does not use the PC logo-outline shader.
review_notes.desktop_content_setup: Windows local converter and APK/PCK output remain desktop-only.
